description: This Kotlin source file defines the ManageNotebooksFragment class, which manages the UI for displaying, sorting, and interacting with notebooks in an Android app. It handles recycler view setup, menu actions, sorting, and user interactions such as item clicks and long presses.

classes.name: ManageNotebooksFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment class that manages the display and interaction with a list of notebooks, including sorting, selection, and navigation.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Initializes the fragment view, sets up recycler view, and configures toolbar actions.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates the options menu for notebook management.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selections such as creating notebooks and changing sort order.

methods.name: onDestroyView
methods.description: Cleans up references when the view is destroyed.

methods.name: setupRecyclerView
methods.description: Configures the recycler view, adapter, and user interaction handlers.

methods.name: enlistNotebooks
methods.description: Collects and sorts notebooks based on user preferences, updating the UI.

methods.name: selectSortMethodItem
methods.description: Updates the menu to reflect the current sort method.
